content_data.project_title: Visual Identity Redesign for 'NutriTech' Consumer Engagement Platform
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive visual identity redesign project focused on enhancing user engagement and brand recognition for a new food-tech consumer platform, 'NutriTech'. This includes a fresh aesthetic direction and strategic application across all touchpoints.
content_data.timeline: Initial concept phase: 4 weeks; Development & Iteration: 8 weeks; Implementation support: 4 weeks (total 16 weeks)
objectives: Differentiate 'NutriTech' from competitors within the regional food-tech market.
Develop a modern, appealing, and memorable visual identity for the 'NutriTech' platform.
Establish a consistent brand voice and visual language across all platform elements and marketing materials.
Improve user engagement metrics by 20% through intuitive and aesthetically pleasing design.
deliverables: Comprehensive Brand Style Guide (logo usage, typography, color palette, imagery guidelines)
Presentation Template for Internal & External Use
UX/UI Design System Sketchups for key platform modules (dashboard, profile, content feed)
Marketing Collateral Templates (social media graphics, ad banners, email newsletters)
Refined Logo Suite (primary, secondary, and iconographic variations)
inspiration_references: Sustainable food branding for color psychology and organic textures.
Leading health and wellness app interfaces for clean aesthetics and user flow.
technical_specs: Color palettes to be provided in CMYK, RGB, and Hex codes for print and digital consistency.
UI components designed with responsiveness in mind, adaptable for mobile and desktop.
All assets to be delivered in vector format (SVG, AI, EPS) for scalability.
Typography choices must include freely available or licensed web fonts.
All digital assets optimized for web performance (e.g., compressed PNG/JPG for imagery).
